value.rationale: Exact quasi-idempotent generating rank is a natural structural invariant studied by the motivating paper. The theorem determines it uniformly for all n>=4, replaces a conjectured sharp upper bound by a smaller exact formula in infinitely many cases, and explains the modular periodicity through a finite-state connectivity structure; it is not a routine numerical recomputation.
